anomalies.observed: On the EthernetAndPower sheet the barrel-jack J11 is wired with its center contact (pin 1) tied to NET0031 (the battery/switch node) and pin 3 tied to NET0024, which is the BAT+ rail (the same net that feeds IC2 VIN/EN, J6 VBUS and input cap C14). Pin 2 is tied to GND. Because the jack's pins 2 and 3 are shorted when no plug is inserted, NET0024 (BAT+) is shorted to GND in battery operation; the isolation diode U11 (SS2040FL) ends up sitting between NET0024 and NET0031 rather than in series between the cell and BAT+.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the intended mapping 'J4.1→BAT+ (center/positive), J4.2→GND (sleeve), J4.3→BAT-' with the note '2 and 3 are shorted with no plug / 1 is center, center is positive', i.e. the center pin must feed BAT+ directly and the switch contact must connect the battery return (BAT-) to GND. The battery must reach BAT+ through U11 in the forward direction (anode on cell+, cathode on BAT+). This is exactly the 'DC PLUG PINS ARE WRONG, SHORTS BATTERY' fault (commit a1d9676) that rev D (af0d263) was supposed to correct.

evidence.quote: Netlist: J4.1→BAT+ (center/positive), J4.2→GND (sleeve), J4.3→BAT-. ... a1d9676 'Meshinger 1.0 rev B WARNING THE DC PLUG PINS ARE WRONG, SHORTS BATTERY!'
Battery (U7, 18650 holder) → pin 1 → Net-(U6-A) → U6 (SS2040FL) anode→cathode → BAT+.
EthernetAndPower sheet: J11 'Barrel Jack Switch' pin 1 → NET0031, pin 3 → NET0024, pin 2 → GND; U11 SS2040FL between NET0024 and NET0031; C14 2.2uF from NET0024 to GND; IC2 A2/B2 on NET0024.

anomalies.impact: With no DC plug inserted, the BAT+ rail is shorted to ground through the jack's normally-closed 2-3 contact, so the regulator input and the 3.3 V rail collapse and the cell is shorted; the battery-isolation diode also fails to block USB/adapter back-feed into the cell. The board cannot operate on battery and risks a hazardous battery short.

parsed.summary: Most of the design (FAN53610 regulator, EPD driver values and signal mapping, keyboard, display power switch) matches the specification, but the DC barrel jack J11 and battery diode U11 are interconnected so that BAT+ (NET0024) is shorted to GND via the jack's 2-3 contact and the cell is not isolated by U11 in series, reproducing the documented 'DC plug pins wrong, shorts battery' fault that rev D was meant to fix.
